corrections.text: The article says the Gradle 9.9.0 release notes give the release date as 2026-11-07, while the GitHub release page carries a 2026-11-06 17:17 UTC timestamp. The release notes actually say "released 2026-11-06", so the two sources agree on November 6, 2026 and there is no date discrepancy between them. (GitHub's API records the release as published at 2026-11-06T17:17:32Z.)
